def serve_cmd(host: Optional[str] = None, port: Optional[int] = None) -> None:
    """Local review UI; publishing requires an approved draft and explicit action."""
    try:
        import uvicorn

        from .serve import app as webapp
    except ModuleNotFoundError:
        typer.echo("Missing UI packages. In the venv run:  pip install -e '.[dev]'")
        raise typer.Exit(code=1)

    settings = get_settings()
    bind_host = host or settings.operator_host
    if bind_host not in {"127.0.0.1", "localhost", "::1"}:
        typer.echo("Refusing a non-loopback host; the review UI is local-only.")
        raise typer.Exit(code=1)
    uvicorn.run(webapp, host=bind_host, port=port or settings.operator_port)
